correctness.rationale: Kummer/Legendre give exact digit identities; each of the three carry states and six bit transitions is checked, with terminal carry explicitly included. Inverting I-zA/2 proves the complete finite-block GF for all L. A nonzero symbolic 3-by-3 Hankel determinant proves generic state minimality. Differentiation and exact coefficient extraction give the moments; independent integer enumeration through L=14 and exact rational checks through L=15 corroborate all displayed identities. No finite sample is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete coefficient law determines all simultaneous divisibility frequencies for two natural binomial families at every finite dyadic length. Explicit alternating finite covariance corrections and a provably minimal linear transfer add arithmetic information absent from mere asymptotic correlations and support sets. The result is useful for exact finite-block conditional frequencies and moments; it neither claims a new central limit theorem nor trivializes the finite refinements.
